sentences.text: The petitioners, as being aggrieved owners of the land which has come under land acquisition in terms of the Jammu & Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 in terms of an award dated 23.01.2021, are seeking to undermine the entire land acquisition proceedings by reference to the fact that under the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization (Removal of Difficulties) Order, 2019 issued vide SO 3912 (E) dated 30.10.2019 clause-14, the exercise was required to be carried out under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: The petitioner's acquired land measuring 4.2 kanals which came to be part of 169.4 kanals of land in village Jabowal Kalan, tehsil Arnia, district Jammu was acquired for the purpose of construction of 135 ft. wide strip by composite bandh of Indo Pak Border.
2. Prima facie case is made out.
